entities.name: Steven Aldercrest
entities.description: Scholar and keeper of the Aldercrest estate who prepared for Khalid's attack for eleven years and sacrificed his life to delay him.
entities.quote: I've known you were coming for eleven years. The specific evening was less certain.

entities.name: Eldrich Aldercrest
entities.description: Son of Steven Aldercrest who developed courage and nobility, fighting Khalid to protect his father and the legacy of the Aldercrest estate.
entities.quote: You're not supposed to be dangerous yet.

entities.name: Norman
entities.description: Fearless fighter with resonance reading abilities who was cursed with demonic blood by Khalid in a brutal lower quarter alleyway battle.
entities.quote: You hit harder than the myths say.

entities.name: Dorian Cross
entities.description: Savage and humorous fighter with a Dante-like personality who arrived at the Aldercrest estate to confront Khalid.

entities.name: Piedro
entities.description: Elderly man who attempted to protect his grandson at Issabela's grave before being killed by Khalid.

updates.new_facts: Fought Khalid in the lower quarter and was cursed with a drop of Khalid's blood, beginning his dark transformation into the Paleborne.
updates.quote: A drop of his blood. One drop. Forced past Norman's lips.

timeline_events.title: Norman's Curse in the Alley
timeline_events.description: Norman fights Khalid in a dark Istanbul alley using his resonance abilities but is ultimately overpowered and injected with Khalid's demonic blood.
timeline_events.quote: The two of them regarded each other for a moment. The Resonance reading activated immediately.

timeline_events.title: The Fall of Steven Aldercrest
timeline_events.description: Khalid infiltrates the Aldercrest estate and fatally wounds Steven Aldercrest during a battle for the Architect's Cube.
timeline_events.quote: Steven interposed himself. The cost of that interposition was immediate and final. He went down.
